description: Starts tracking a website in the user's Citemark account: sets up the questions buyers ask AI about its category and the competitors to compare it with, then asks AI assistants those questions on the account's schedule and shows the results on the Citemark dashboard. Needs the user's Citemark account; Claude asks them to connect it the first time. Does nothing if the website is already tracked.

category.description: Optional: what kind of product it is, like 'uptime monitoring tool'. Read from the homepage when left out.

website.description: The product's website, like acme.com (a full URL works too).

name: start_tracking
title: Start tracking a website
